Bounded extraction identifies vhds as a conditional source-path writer of MQTT/AA000165, including three built-in entries with IDs347/4BF/44A. points: This report qualifies no new live operation and contains no current table snapshot.
Internal getOwner/getCanMap methods require an in-process HAL object; symbol existence does not provide a public API or authorize hooking a process.
Negative Java token search is limited to explicit files, tokens and retained decompilation; JNI, computed IDs, omitted decompiles and unextracted services remain open.
SecretOBD pointer offset differs from ordinary raw streams in extended envelope mode; byte layout remains opaque.
Current MQTT deliveries from the earlier pass establish that stream delivery occurred then, not which application owns its table, which keys were loaded, or whether7E8/7EE existed on wire.
Source-backed file reading is separate from invoking loader/parser methods, which may configure tables.
VHDS demonstrates the native-search limit: exact32-bit FID literals were absent, but split instruction/global values prove AA000165 writes. Negative string/literal search is not semantic absence.
